what_was_measured: Literature identifiers for each curated type, from THREE SEPARATE sources with the source recorded ON EACH RECORD: identifiers written in this project's own curation (curated), the primary citation of the type's PDB entry (pdb_primary), and the reference list of the reference protein's UniProt entry (uniprot).
what_this_is_not: A record appearing here does NOT mean that paper supports this type's substrate assignment. Only `curated` records are the basis this project cites; `uniprot` records are the entry's reference list, and only those marked `function_evidence` are attached by UniProt as evidence for a statement about what the enzyme does.

absence_is_classified.what_this_means: A type with no identifier is not one thing. `declared_none` means this project's curation explicitly records that no individual citation exists for the reference enzyme: it was looked for. `none_found` means no identifier was found and no such statement was made, so it is an open item.

doi_resolution.method: GET https://doi.org/api/handles/<doi>; responseCode 1 means the DOI is registered. The publisher's page is NOT opened: many publishers answer an automated request with an error, and reading that error as a dead DOI marked 79 of 125 valid DOIs as broken in the first version of this check
